title: Fixed-50 minimal-operation coverage audit
purpose: Determine whether a genuinely new low-risk factor operation remains hidden in the existing 51 historical hybrids before expanding the generator contract.

method.distance: For each hybrid, compute Hamming distance over A/B/C/D/E from every fixed-50 historical source and retain its minimum distance.
method.pattern: Record which factor slots differ at each nearest source.
method.scene_proxy: Use v0.35 semantic_cohesion/source_fields only as a historical research filter, not as a naturalness verdict.

single_factor_findings.interpretation: The existing fixed-50 factor graph yields no novel hybrid that is a one-factor B-only, C-only, or D-only edit of a historical source.

two_factor_findings.interpretation: The only high-cohesion two-factor paths are A+E compositions inside the already-established autumn/moon family.

operation_assessment.coverage: no minimum-distance-1 candidate in fixed50 hybrid graph
operation_assessment.reason: No empirical positive lane to justify adding the operation.

The high-cohesion examples remain inside the already-established autumn/moon family and can be understood as composition of two already-modeled low-risk operations rather than evidence for a third family.

operation_assessment.reason: Current fixed50 evidence does not justify enabling these blocks as a new low-risk operation.

bottleneck.statement: Within the current fixed-50 hybrid graph, operation invention is no longer the main bottleneck for establishing a third positive family.
reasons: All minimum-distance-1 novelty is already captured by A-only or E-only operations.
High-cohesion minimum-distance-2 novelty is confined to A+E compositions within the existing autumn/moon family.
Other two-factor patterns are cross-field/low-cohesion and would require relaxing current safety gates.
bottleneck.implication: A third positive family now requires either stronger source confirmation for an unresolved candidate (musu or travel) or new historically verified source material that creates a new narrow-scene lane.

next_action: Do not expand the operation contract merely to increase candidate count. Search for source-confirmable unresolved families or new verified historical records first.
